notes.title: [The Bridge Curse Road to Salvation] Steam Halloween Sale Kickoff
notes.notes:
Developed by Softstar, [The Bridge Curse Road to Salvation]’s sales surged since its launch in August and ranked 2nd in the Top Sellers list. Since the last week of October is Halloween in the western world and to be in concert with STEAM [Scream Fest], [The Bridge Curse Road to Salvation] will be 10% off from 10/25 10:00 AM to 11/1 10:00 AM (PDT). Please seize this opportunity to purchase the game if you haven’t already.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603358/5e1e6ce6cbd708a9936926fd8f3703b2318f583a.png[/img]

Adapted From a Real Horror Movie / Great Reviews From Domestic and International Streamers
Adapted from the best-selling movie [The Bridge Curse], [The Bridge Curse Road to Salvation] is a first-person horror game with stealth-based gameplay which offers players an immersive horror experience. The game raises its curtain by having six university students hosting a Kimodameshi camp for the new student orientation as they challenge the legend of a female ghost claiming lives in the middle of the night on campus. It’s been two months since its launch and it has already earned the “Overwhelmingly Positive” review rating on STEAM as more positive reviews come. Famous YouTubers and streamers in the U.S., Thailand, Japan, China, and such have also live-streamed their [The Bridge Curse Road to Salvation] gameplay, created hilarious content of fan remakes, and received great feedback online.

Vivid Characters With Hints Hidden in Details Took the Players by Storm
The characters in [The Bridge Curse Road to Salvation] are very well-made in terms of character roles and images, for instance, LinEn Cheng the tough girl who is brave enough to talk smack to the female ghost has everyone cheering for her when she heavy-kicks the ghost or WenYao Li who usually rattles on and on still showcases his masculine side in critical situations. Furthermore, blending real-life occurrences into the game script was also one of the things the producer really worked hard on. The scene where the well-built TianMing Li has to dig into the toilet by hand to retrieve the talisman that he accidentally dropped is impressive and hard to forget. There are tons of hints hidden in the details and story for players to discover themselves.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603358/f4878a7b8c63f5bf14ed2b0a25b1eae268554450.png[/img]

Cosplay as a Ghost to Celebrate Halloween for Free Game Code
In celebration of Halloween, besides the STEAM [Scream Fest] 10% off sales event, the official fan page of [The Bridge Curse Road to Salvation] will simultaneously host the [Ghost Front Halloween Celebration] event, inviting all fans to upload their Halloween cosplay photos, female-ghost makeup photos, and even selfies with funny faces to the specified posting section. The player who gets the most Likes with his/her post will have a chance to get [The Bridge Curse Road to Salvation] Digital Deluxe Edition!

notes.title: [The Bridge Curse Road to Salvation] Available on STEAM Today
notes.notes:
Developed by Softstar and adapted from the Taiwanese thriller movie, [The Bridge Curse], [The Bridge Curse Road to Salvation] is a first-person horror game with stealth-based gameplay that is officially available on STEAM today with a price of 19.99 USD . A hand covered in black blood lifts up the curtain in the latest released teaser trailer. The odd and twisted faces of the six members in a faded group photo of the camp cadres give off a sinister vibe, as if quite a few mysteries were swept under the rug.

[previewyoutube=jtACW3VycJM;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]An Old Faded Photo Drawing Out the Backstory of Blood and Tears[/b]

Based on the horrifying legend in TungHu University, the game tells a story of six students doing a rehearsal of a Kimodameshi camp for the new student orientation and putting themselves at risk to challenge all kinds of taboos associated with the Bridge Curse. Legend has it that an additional step would be added to the flight of stairs at midnight where a female ghost would then appear and claim lives. Besides finding ways to survive while taking flight, the complicated and checkered interpersonal relationships under the table will also bring about twists and turns while players deal with the fear of facing unknown ghosts. The human's hater mentality, paranoia, and true emotions that are deeply hidden will be exposed one after another as the story progresses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603358/140f5ca10c5a6e57e15ed5eb6c9f854faf18d117.jpg[/img]

An old faded photo

[b]Crack the Puzzle Missions Where Details Are Hidden in the Youthful and Funny Gags[/b]

Players will play the roles of six characters in the game and experience the characters' encounters and feelings from a first-person perspective. You will not only enjoy the mini puzzle games and the stealth-based gameplay where you have to hide from ghosts, but also gather all kinds of items of everyday use to complete the collection and unlock hidden surprises. Besides that, [The Bridge Curse Road to Salvation] not only has the scary and horrifying nature found exclusively in horror games, but also integrates many hilarious elements and funny gags that will put smiles on your face amidst all the scare, such as the doodles in the corners of chalkboards, the wall of comments in the bathroom stalls, and the familiar brands of snacks and drinks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603358/b3608a50199a93f02d78c2fcab7ab1aae4f9d829.jpg[/img]

[b]All Eyes on the Release of the Local Horror Game[/b]

A high-profile game that has the attention of a great deal of [The Bridge Curse] movie fans and horror game players, [The Bridge Curse Road to Salvation] has accumulated tens of thousands of wishlists on STEAM since it was first announced. It is officially available today on Aug. 25th at noon (2022.8.24 @ 9:00pm PDT). The original version is priced at 19.99 USD

notes.title: The Bridge Curse Road to Salvation Locally Developed Horror Game
notes.notes:
Softstar’s highly-anticipated new horror game "The Bridge Curse: Road to Salvation" is set to hit the market soon. This horror game, adapted from the 2020 thriller The Bridge Curse, combines puzzle solving, action and role-playing elements. Set against the backdrop of Taiwan's top ten campus horror legends, characters in the game participate in a Kimodameshi as the main plot line, and a variety of terrifying scenarios cleverly integrated into the game to create a very fitting ambience. The game's six fearless college student characters have also been revealed for the first time.

Distinct Personalities and Intriguing Storylines

The game describes six fearless college students on campus who challenge horrific campus legends that have been circulating for years. Legend has it that a female ghost has been lingering on the school bridge for years, trapped in her quest for vengeance. No one knows where she came from, only know that at midnight the number of steps will increase by one, and she appear and seek someone to take her place!  The game's heroine, HsinChiao Chao, has a heavy workload in her graduate studies, but possesses a lively and cheerful demeanor, and is eager to help others.  This prompted her to help plan this terrifying Kimodameshi as a senior, hoping to bring to the younger underclassmen an unforgettable memory in orientation camp!

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603358/6ccb7c20a4322b138e35bc85841657d354d9c9d7.png[/img]
A key organizer of the Kimodameshi: Graduate student HsinChiao Chao

　　The main protagonist of this game – DeCyuan Ji, with his striking good looks and approachable personality, got the attention of everyone as soon as he arrived on campus. He has since become one of the most recognizable faces in school! His romantic trysts are also a mystery to the public. He is not only responsible for maintaining order and the rules during the Kimodameshi, but also has accepted a special secret mission that must be carried out on the day of the rehearsal of the Ghost Bridge Kimodameshi event. What secrets are lurking behind his facade?

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603358/f6cfd6be71bf6494ff07280e99109d3940dae265.png[/img]
A legend on Campus of TungHu: DeCyuan Ji

Local Inspiration and Authentic Taiwanese Dubbing



This first-person stealth horror adventure game, " The Bridge Curse: Road to Salvation", was first revealed on the STEAM platform around mid-February and has attracted a lot of attention and demo play. The game is a realistic recreation of a typical Taiwan campus scene, including the strange concave bridge, the old and dilapidated mobile toilet, the corner dormitory unoccupied for many years, the art classroom full of scary dolls and so on…The entire game was dubbed in Mandarin by professional Taiwanese dubbers, with the authentic Taiwanese colloquial phrases such as "Sa Xiao?" (what’s up), "Kao Bei!" (fxxking hell), etc., bringing players an authentic Taiwanese flavor. The interpretation of each character's personalities and distinct traits is not only deep and profound, but also very much in line with local culture and folklore!

Professional Actors and Realistic Motion Capture

　　Since the release of the demo version of "The Bridge Curse: Road to Salvation", it has been highly anticipated by horror game players from all over the world. During game development, professional Taiwanese film actors were invited to participate in motion capture to vividly and realistically interpret the frightening storyline. The first-person perspective of the game adds more immersion to the game, allowing players to come face to face with truly terrifying scenarios.

In addition to faithfully retaining the characters from the famous horror movie The Bridge Curse, the game adds two new characters that were not featured in the movie, allowing for more parallel development of the plot and adding many variables to the game's storyline, making it even more intriguing. To unveil more of the secrets behind the "The Bridge Curse: Road to Salvation", join the Steam wishlist now at:

notes.title: The Bridge Curse Road to Salvation available on Steam on 8/25
notes.notes:
Softstar Entertainment’s newest horror masterpiece, The Bridge Curse Road to Salvation, will be available on Steam on August 25, and its second wave of promotional videos has just been released. The game, adapted from the 2020 thriller film The Bridge Curse, is based on the top ten horror stories of Taiwanese campuses. In addition to expanding upon characters that were not in the movie, many puzzles and artifacts have been incorporated into the game to increase the difficulty of each level of the game.

The Bridge Curse: Road to Salvation available on Steam on 8/25: Second wave of trailers (Multi-language subtitles)
[previewyoutube=7Qz4skUBgZI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Based on local urban legends[/h3]

    According to rumors, there is a horror story that has been passed down for many years at TungHu University. The story goes that the ghost of a female student haunts a bridge in the campus, and every 4 years, she snatches another student to take her place. A group of fearless TungHu students decided to challenge the legend of the bridge ghost to boost their live stream viewer count; they held a daring adventure in the quiet campus when no one was around. The group held their breath and trembled as they took part in the test, but little did they expect to have the ghost actually show up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603358/87c0892f3d9fa424dbef240ef853c9a4c8f3f12d.jpg[/img]

[h3]Hiding and solving mysteries at the same time; facing your fears unarmed[/h3]

    The game is a first-person stealth game, combining action and puzzle solving. As a terrifying ghost approaches from out of nowhere, players will take on different characters and dash from one corner of the campus to another to escape from various dangers. Players have to conceal themselves in hidden spaces to avoid the murderous ghost, and rack their brains to find clues and solve puzzles in order to have a chance to escape. Many seemingly insignificant props can be picked up and carefully studied to discover what is hidden inside them. Whether players can finally break the curse of bridge ghost depends on their skills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603358/c38077684b0f73616c657be4145523b240b37acf.jpg[/img]

[h3]More exciting plot, more detailed storylines[/h3]

    The game was adapted from the famous thriller film The Bridge Curse. In addition to adding two new characters that were not in the movie, the game also has new additional plot to make the game’s story fuller and the experience more thrilling and exciting. As the plot evolves and advances step by step towards the end, the unknown secrets behind the female ghost and the intricate relationships between the students will gradually rise to the surface, and they are waiting to be discovered and experienced by players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603358/6ee9c9f8d4f4854545270338668d83f59f914010.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603358/938f4cc17b22f1f8024d90654b72a537b92c2743.jpg[/img]

[h3]Steam Version only US$19.99[/h3]

The Bridge Curse: Road to Salvation will be available on STEAM on August 25. The game supports traditional Chinese, simplified Chinese, Thai, English, Japanese, German, Spanish, and the regular version is priced at US$19.99. There is also a digital deluxe version package that has a book on the game production process, including game art, concept designs, behind-the-scenes footage and more, making it good value for the money.
